Each rep asserts (operation-performance-b.integration.test.ts ~L271-273) that per arm the count of plan_runs == template instances == samples, work items == 3 x samples and all done, and that every sample carries a distinct runId; all 5 reps exited rc=0 so the assertions held on both arms.

The first rep4 attempt (ended 18:32:11Z rc=1, preserved as .papercusp/scratch/p013-b/matrix-rep4.failed-ipc-race.log) failed because a cold child process exited (SIGKILL, self-inflicted after its IPC send) before the parent consumed the p013-sample message: the parent listened on child "exit", which can fire before the queued IPC message is delivered. Rig-only fix: the parent now waits on "close". rep4 was rerun alone (run-matrix.sh 4 4) 18:45:37Z-19:34:32Z rc=0. The failed attempt produced no graded sample and is excluded.

2 blob-fingerprint sets across reps. The only difference is operation-performance-b.integration.test.ts (bebf7d879d in rep0-3, b27622de4f in rep4), the rig-only exit->close IPC listener change above; driver, child, operation-admission.ts and operation-service.ts blobs are identical in all 5 reps.

rig: Dedicated native PostgreSQL per repetition, deterministic fixture worker (claim + complete with 1 KiB result), process-isolated cold child per cold sample, getOrgPg stand-in pool sized like production pgPoolMax=52 (D-024). Blocker-edge promotion race fixed first (WI-10003675).
load: Box load average ~53 at matrix start (14:15Z, other fleet work running) and ~22 at the rep4 rerun (18:45Z). Both arms run inside the same rep process on the same dedicated cluster, so each bar compares arms measured under similar load; absolute latencies are load-inflated.
notProven: Actual-model latency: this matrix uses a deterministic fixture worker only.
Absolute latency on an idle box: the box was shared with fleet work throughout; only the paired candidate/control ratio is graded.
